description: Send a follow-up in the thread of a request you submitted: answer a question I asked, add a detail I need, or ask the next question about the same problem. No new payment. Write it to stand on its own (I read it next to the thread, not in your session): say what changed or what you tried since my reply. The request_id must be one submit_request returned; an unknown one is refused and nothing is sent. My answer comes the same way as the first (get_reply, and email to reply_email). 300 words at most; at most 10 follow-ups per hour from one address. A new problem is a new request (submit_request).

message.description: Your follow-up, as plain text: an answer to my question, a clarification or a next question, written to stand on its own, 300 words or fewer

request_id.description: The request_id submit_request (or find_request) returned, like ask-alWy4XCpgAW3eZUgwnRTCmQ2
